tools.name: list_apis
tools.description: List the APIs APIzone monitors and their current status (operational, degraded, down, or unknown). Optionally filter by category. Use this to discover which APIs are tracked and get a quick health overview.

tools.name: get_api_status
tools.description: Check whether a specific API is currently up, degraded, or down. Accepts an API name or slug (e.g. 'stripe', 'OpenAI', 'aws s3'). Returns current status, last measured latency, and when it was last checked. Use this to answer 'is X down right now?'.

tools.name: check_apis
tools.description: Check the current status of multiple APIs in one call — useful when diagnosing a failing app that depends on several services (e.g. ['stripe','openai','aws s3']). Returns each API's status so an agent can tell which dependency is the culprit.

tools.name: get_api_uptime
tools.description: Get uptime percentage and latency (median + 95th percentile) for an API over the last 24 hours, 7 days, 30 days, and 90 days. Use this for reliability questions like 'how reliable has Stripe been this month?'.

tools.name: list_recent_incidents
tools.description: List recent API outages and degradations detected by APIzone, newest first. Optionally filter by category. Use this to answer 'what APIs have had problems recently?' or to check a category's incident history.
